items.text: Marketing, tenant selection and rental management.
Renting with peace of mind starts with choosing the right tenant.
For landlords who want to rent without worry: we market the property, carefully select tenants and guide you through the contract. If you prefer, we also manage the rental throughout the tenancy.
You choose how far we go
Preparation and listing of the advertisement
Renewals, updates and end of tenancy

items.title: Initial conversation
items.text: We understand the property and the conditions you are looking for.

items.title: Property preparation
items.text: We review the documentation and, if needed, the condition of the flat.

items.title: Marketing
items.text: We list the property and respond to interested parties.

items.title: Selection
items.text: We review the candidates with you. The decision is always yours.

items.title: Contract and management
items.text: We formalise the contract and, if you choose, manage the rental.

items.q: What documents do I need to let my property?
items.a: In Catalonia, the habitation certificate and the energy efficiency certificate. If you don't have them, our architect can arrange them.

items.q: How do you choose the tenant?
items.a: We review their solvency and documentation and present you with the matching candidates. You always make the final decision.

items.q: Do you handle the contract and deposit?
items.a: Yes. We prepare the contract and manage the deposit lodgement with INCASÒL, as required by Catalan regulations.

items.q: What if there's a problem during the tenancy?
items.a: If you opt for management, we handle incidents. And if a legal dispute arises, we coordinate with the law firm we work with. [See legal and tax advice](service:asesoramiento-juridico-fiscal).

items.text: Every good decision starts with a conversation. Let's talk about yours.
